qualification: partial A1 page-10 source read of A3 and its two external compensation networks; this does not identify or qualify P09A electrically

views.description: 300 dpi A3 and vertical-driver crop, page-image rectangle (100,1550)-(1150,2650)

scope.omitted_neighbours: Input resistor and diode networks, supply decoupling, output bias chain after R48, and other page-10 parts remain outside this partial read

reading_notes: A3 uses eight active physical pins of a 14-pin outline: 3/12 for input compensation, 4/5 for inverting/noninverting input, 6/11 for negative/positive supply, and 9/10 for output compensation/output. The KiCad functional symbol renumbers these as 1 through 8; the translation above is explicit, not an electrical identification of P09A as LM709.
C26 joins physical pin 12 to the upper end of R54; R54 returns to physical pin 3. Neither compensation branch is tied directly to the negative rail in this crop.
C27 joins physical output-compensation pin 9 to output pin 10. R48 begins at pin 10 and feeds the separately checked output-bias chain.
The upper input line reaches physical pin 5 (+), the lower reaches pin 4 (-); the supply lines reach pins 11 and 6 respectively.
